title: luc-todo CSV import: one row = one task
description: Describes one data row of the import CSV once read as text (every CSV cell is a string; an empty cell means 'not set'). The first row of the file must be a header naming the columns below (any order, any letter case; spaces or hyphens count as underscores). Only 'title' is required. 11 columns: title, list, category, due_date, remind_time, repeat, priority, quick, must_today, notes, subtasks. Unknown columns are ignored. Dates may also be written DD/MM/YYYY (what Excel produces in the UK); keywords like 'tomorrow' are NOT accepted in a CSV. The server (api/_bulk.js) is the only judge: if any row fails, nothing is added.

title.description: The task text. Required. Line breaks are turned into spaces. A title containing the word 'session' becomes a checklist task (same as quick add).

list.description: Which list the task goes on. Empty = personal. Any letter case is accepted.

category.description: Personal: a free-text tag shown on the task (e.g. Home, Health). Work: the project name; if it matches an existing Work project (any letter case) that project's exact name is used, otherwise it is kept as typed. Empty = none.

due_date.description: Due date, a real calendar date. YYYY-MM-DD (preferred) or DD/MM/YYYY (day first; also D/M/YYYY and dots). Past dates are allowed (the task shows as overdue). Empty = no date, except when repeat, remind_time or must_today is set (then today).

remind_time.description: Time of day, 24-hour HH:MM (09:30, 14:00; 9:05 is accepted). Puts the task in Apple Calendar with an alert if that is connected. Empty = no time.

repeat.description: Makes the task repeat. Any letter case is accepted. Empty = does not repeat. Starts on due_date (today if empty).

priority.description: Work-list priority: 0 = none, 1 = !, 2 = !!, 3 = !!! (most important). Whole numbers only. Empty = 0.

quick.description: Mark as a quick task (Work list ordering). yes/no, true/false, y/n or 1/0, any letter case. Empty = no.

must_today.description: Mark as 'Must do today'. yes/no, true/false, y/n or 1/0, any letter case. Empty = no. If yes, due_date must be empty, today or earlier (empty becomes today); a later date is an error.

notes.description: Free-text notes shown in the task's detail sheet. Light markdown is shown formatted under the notes box: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, '- ' bullets, '1.' lists, '# ' headings, [text](https://link). Line breaks are kept (put the cell in quotes). Only add notes when real context was given. Empty = none.

subtasks.description: Sub-tasks (the task's checklist). Separate items with | (or line breaks). Start an item with [x] to mark it done. Up to 100 items, each up to 200 characters. Empty = none.

x-file.format: CSV, UTF-8 (in Excel: Save As > 'CSV UTF-8'). Comma separated (semicolon also read). Cells containing commas, quotes or line breaks go in double quotes; a quote inside is doubled.
x-file.allOrNothing: If any row is invalid nothing is added; the page lists the line numbers and reasons.
x-file.duplicates: Importing the same file twice adds every task twice.
x-file.pasting: The same CSV text can be pasted into Settings > Import > Paste CSV (works on phones and iPad).
